αἴης: αἶα — land, earth; gen. sg., epic by-form of γαῖα
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen.
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μόρον: μόρος — portion, fate, allotted share; acc. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ
νέηται: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. subj. 3 sg.
νοστήσαντα: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having returned’
νυ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νόστιμον: νόστιμος — of homecoming, of return; neut. acc. sg., in νόστιμον ἦμαρ ’day of return’
νόσφι: νόσφι — apart from, except (+ gen.); adv./prep.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πήματα: πῆμα — suffering, woe, calamity; neut. acc. pl.
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen.
πατρίδος: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; gen. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ)
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’
ταλασίφρονος: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; gen. sg. (epithet of Odysseus, from τλῆναι ’endure’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg.: ’him’; also relative: ’whom’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀμφιρύτῃ: ἀμφίρυτος — sea-girt, flowed round on all sides; fem. dat. sg.
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat.
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen.
ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut./masc. acc. sg.
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔχῃσιν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic ἔχῃ)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj.
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + acc. (ὑπὲρ μόρον ’beyond one’s portion’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως)
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
